title: 341_110677_Numerical_File,_5-2500
doc_notes: This is a declassified U.S. Air Attache intelligence report (IR 193-55) detailing observations by a U.S. delegation in the USSR, including a significant UFO encounter.

encounters.summary: Three U.S. observers, including Senator Richard Russell, witnessed two unconventional disc-shaped aircraft take off vertically near a rail line in the Trans Caucasus region of the USSR.
encounters.entity_appearance: Round, circular, disc-shaped, resembling a discus; outer surface revolved slowly clockwise; two stationary lights on top.
encounters.entity_behavior: Ascended almost vertically at slow speed to 6000 feet, then increased speed sharply in horizontal flight heading north.
encounters.quote: Two round and circular unconventional aircraft resembling flying discs or flying saucers were seen taking off almost vertically one minute apart.
